scope: Narrow local source and AST review of the thin supervisor only; no import, execution, tests, network, host access, or re-review of the original operator.

checks.detail: Repository and operations path are fixed; commit accepts exactly 40 lowercase hex characters. Only the two literal pinned filenames are fetched. Redirects are rejected; no alternate URL or retry exists.

Each download reads at most expected length plus one, requires HTTP 200, and validates exact size and SHA256 before exclusive write. Worker repeats the pinned read with O_NOFOLLOW and regular-file check. Socket timeout is 30 seconds per network operation.

mkdtemp uses /tmp with task prefix and umask 077. Worker requires a real, current-euid-owned directory at a direct /tmp child with mode 0700 and canonical path. Writes are exclusive; helper retains its task-specific filename, so no operator.py shadow is created. Exclusive worker-start receipt prevents another worker invocation in the same stage.

Pinned helper is compiled without execution before background launch and again before the sole helper Popen. Helper command is an argv list, uses current Python with -B, cwd /app, DEVNULL stdin and close_fds. No shell is invoked.

Both children remove PYTHONOPTIMIZE, PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH, set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and use -B. main rejects optimized Python. This is the stated Python-variable sanitization, not a claim of a complete environment allowlist.

Background worker starts a new session and captures supervisor.log. Helper stdout/stderr are separate exclusive files, flushed and fsynced. Normal completion or a caught Exception records helper PID, actual return code, worker error and log sizes/hashes. Parent explicitly reports STARTED_NOT_RESULT.

Only background-worker Popen and one helper Popen exist. There is no automatic retry, cleanup, rollback, kill, service restart, guard/lease creation, publish, or foreign deletion performed by this wrapper.

limits: Static review only; successful download, launch, rehearsal, or publication is not established.
The 30-second urllib timeout is a socket-operation timeout, not an independent whole-download wall-clock deadline; byte consumption is strictly capped.
No exit receipt is guaranteed after abrupt worker kill, host loss, or failure to persist evidence. A launch receipt is not a rehearsal result; the original helper receipt remains required.
One-helper property is per private stage. A new manual launcher invocation creates another attempt; no automatic repeat is present.

Exact-D CI and final operator/envelope review are external prerequisites. Root reports D CI 11/11 PASS; this review did not independently query CI. Fresh host/foreign/lock/lease and original guard checks remain in the pinned helper.
gate_owner: root; this review changes no release state or authorization
